articles.title: Bitcoin nears $65K as Trump says Hormuz will 'open to all' in Sunday Iran peace deal
articles.snippet: Bitcoin stayed near local highs on a new US-Iran peace deal pledge as analysis saw conditions favoring a sustained BTC price rebound.

articles.title: Trump says Iran peace deal to be signed Sunday, contradicting Tehran
articles.snippet: Crypto analyst Michaël van de Poppe said a peace deal, which would reopen the Strait of Hormuz, would likely send liquidity back to risk-on assets such as cryptocurrencies.

articles.title: Amazon warning triggered US crackdown on Anthropic AI models: Reports
articles.snippet: Calls from Amazon CEO Andy Jassy and other tech firms prompted the Trump administration to suspend foreign access to Anthropic’s Fable 5 and Mythos 5 AI models on Friday.

articles.title: Sam Bankman-Fried loses appeal to overturn 25-year prison sentence
articles.snippet: A federal appeals court upheld the former FTX chief’s conviction, while his bid for clemency from President Donald Trump appears to face steep political odds.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: SpaceX fuels tokenization’s next boom
articles.snippet: Tokenized RWAs surge despite crypto volatility, Kraken launches SpaceX IPO xStocks, prediction markets outpace onchain gambling and Sam Bankman-Fried seeks a Trump pardon.
